question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as deposits,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as withdrawals
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date LIKE '2020-%'
    GROUP BY customer_id, SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
customer_monthly_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        (deposits - withdrawals) / 1.0 as month_end_balance
    FROM monthly_balances
),
month_customer_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_balance_customers
    FROM customer_monthly_balance
    GROUP BY month
),
avg_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM customer_monthly_balance
    GROUP BY month
),
max_min AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        positive_balance_customers,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY positive_balance_customers DESC) as pos_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY positive_balance_customers ASC) as pos_rank_asc
    FROM month_customer_counts
),
max_month AS (
    SELECT month, positive_balance_customers FROM max_min WHERE pos_rank = 1
),
min_month AS (
    SELECT month, positive_balance_customers FROM max_min WHERE pos_rank_asc = 1
)
SELECT 
    m.month as highest_count_month,
    m.positive_balance_customers as highest_count,
    mn.month as lowest_count_month,
    mn.positive_balance_customers as lowest_count,
    a.avg_balance as highest_avg_balance,
    mn_avg.avg_balance as lowest_avg_balance,
    ROUND(a.avg_balance - mn_avg.avg_balance, 4) as balance_difference
FROM max_month m
CROSS JOIN min_month mn
CROSS JOIN (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month = m.month) a
CROSS JOIN (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month = mn.month) mn_avg
